name: get-automation-runs
description:
**Purpose:** List runs for an automation, or get details of a specific run.

**Modes:**
- With `runId`: Returns detailed run info with step-by-step execution status, outputs, and errors.
- Without `runId`: Lists runs for the automation with optional status filter.

**When to use:**
- User wants to see if an automation is working
- User wants to debug a failed automation run
- User asks "why did this automation fail?" or "show me recent runs"

**Run statuses:** running, completed, failed, cancelled
**Step statuses:** pending, running, completed, failed, skipped, waiting

automationId.description: The automation ID or Resend dashboard URL (e.g. https://resend.com/automations/<id>)

runId.description: Specific run ID to get details for. If omitted, lists all runs.

status.description: Filter runs by status (for list mode only).

limit.description: Number of runs to retrieve (for list mode).

after.description: Cursor for forward pagination (for list mode).

before.description: Cursor for backward pagination (for list mode).
